en.title: The Banking System
en.subtitle: How banks actually work, central banks, deposit insurance, payment systems, digital banking, and choosing the right bank.

lessons.title: How Banks Work
lessons.html:
Banks are the infrastructure of the financial system. Every salary, every purchase, every investment flows through banks. Understanding how they work gives you an edge in every financial decision.

The Core Business Model

Banks make money from the SPREAD — the difference between interest they pay you on deposits and interest they charge borrowers on loans. You deposit at 3%. They lend at 8%. The 5% difference is their profit.

Where Banks Get Money & How They Use It

Source

How It Works

Cost to Bank

Customer Deposits

You put money in savings/checking

Interbank Loans

Banks borrow from each other

Medium (central bank rate)

Central Bank

Bonds Issued

Bank sells its own bonds

Medium-High (coupon)

Fractional Reserve Banking

Banks do NOT keep all your money in a vault. They keep only a fraction (typically 5-15%) as reserves. The rest is lent out.

How $100 Becomes $1,000

You deposit $100. Bank keeps $10 (10% reserve), lends $90 to Person B.

Person B spends $90 — it gets deposited elsewhere. That bank keeps $9, lends $81 to Person C. This continues. Your $100 creates roughly $1,000 in total money supply. This is the money multiplier — how the banking system literally creates money.

This works until too many people withdraw at once (a bank run). That is why deposit insurance exists.

lessons.title: The Central Bank
lessons.html:
The central bank is the most powerful financial institution in any country. Its decisions directly affect every loan rate, deposit rate, and price you pay.

What is a Central Bank?

The institution that manages a country's money supply, sets interest rates, regulates commercial banks, and maintains stability. US: Federal Reserve (Fed). EU: ECB. Uzbekistan: CBU.

Key Functions

→ 1. Setting Interest Rates

The base rate influences ALL borrowing costs. When raised: mortgages, car loans, cards all get more expensive. When lowered: borrowing becomes cheaper. This is the primary tool for controlling the economy.

→ 2. Controlling Inflation

Targets a specific inflation rate (usually 2-4%). Raises rates to slow spending when prices rise too fast. Lowers rates to stimulate the economy when growth stalls.

→ 3. Regulating Banks

Sets reserve requirements, capital ratios, lending standards. Conducts inspections and can shut down unsafe banks.

→ 4. Lender of Last Resort

When a bank faces a liquidity crisis, the central bank provides emergency loans. Prevents bank runs from collapsing the system.

REAL EXAMPLE — How Rate Changes Affect You

Central bank raises the key rate from 5% to 7%:

  • Your variable mortgage: monthly payment increases $150-300.

  • Your savings: interest earned increases slightly (banks are slow to pass this on).

  • Stock market: typically drops — higher rates make bonds more attractive.

  • Housing market: cools down — mortgages become more expensive.

One decision ripples through your mortgage, savings, investments, and the price of everything.

lessons.title: Deposit Insurance
lessons.html:
What happens if your bank goes bankrupt? Banks fail every year. Deposit insurance stands between you and losing everything.

What is Deposit Insurance?

A government-backed guarantee: if your bank fails, you get deposits back up to a limit. US: $250,000 (FDIC). EU: €100,000. Russia: 1.4M rubles. Uzbekistan: 100M UZS.

What IS Covered

Checking accounts — fully covered up to the limit

Savings accounts — fully covered up to the limit

Fixed deposits (CDs) — covered including accrued interest

Money market deposit accounts — covered (not money market FUNDS)

What is NOT Covered

Stocks and bonds — investment products are NOT insured

Mutual funds and ETFs — even if bought through your bank

Cryptocurrency — no government insurance on crypto

Amounts above the limit — split large sums across banks

Strategy: Insuring More Than the Limit

Have $500K? Split it: $250K in Bank A, $250K in Bank B = fully insured. Couples: each person $250K + $250K joint = $750K covered at one bank.

Digital Banking Security Essentials

Enable two-factor authentication (2FA)

Blocks 99% of unauthorized access. Use an authenticator app, not SMS.

Never share passwords or PINs

No bank will ever ask for your full password. Anyone who does is a scammer.

Use unique passwords per bank

If one is breached, others stay safe. Use a password manager.

Monitor transactions weekly

Set alerts for transactions above a threshold. Catch fraud early.

lessons.title: Choosing the Right Bank
lessons.html:
Most people bank wherever is closest or where their parents banked. This passive choice costs thousands in fees and missed interest over a lifetime.

The 8-Point Bank Comparison Checklist

1. Interest Rates

Compare APY. A 1% difference on $20K = $200/year. Over 10 years: $2,000+ free money.

2. Fee Structure

Monthly fees, ATM fees, transfer fees, overdraft. $12/month = $144/year for nothing.

3. ATM Network

Free ATMs available? $3/withdrawal × 4/month = $144/year wasted.

4. Digital Experience

Mobile app quality, online banking, ease of transfers. You use it daily.

5. Deposit Insurance

Is the bank covered? What is the limit? NEVER bank with an uninsured institution.

6. Customer Service

24/7 support? Phone, chat, in-person? Read real customer reviews.

7. Product Range

Checking, savings, deposits, investment accounts, credit cards — all you need?

8. Reputation & Stability

How long operating? Financial health? Check independent ratings.

Core Takeaway — Unit 6

Banks are not just storage — they are the infrastructure every financial decision flows through. Understanding fractional reserve banking, central bank policy, deposit insurance, and digital payments gives you a fundamental advantage. Choose deliberately using the 8-point checklist, keep deposits insured, and embrace digital banking for better rates and lower fees. ZInvest AI can help compare banks, calculate real interest, and optimize your account structure.

glossary.title: Key Terms Glossary
glossary.html:
All important terms from Unit 6

Commercial Bank

Accepts deposits, makes loans, provides payments to the public.

Central Bank

Manages money supply, sets interest rates, regulates banks. Fed, ECB, CBU.

Fractional Reserve

Banks keep only a fraction of deposits in reserve, lend out the rest. Creates money via multiplier.

Reserve Requirement

% of deposits a bank must keep and not lend. Set by central bank. Typically 5-15%.

Key Interest Rate

Rate set by central bank influencing all other rates. Also called policy rate or base rate.

Deposit Insurance

Government guarantee depositors are repaid (up to limit) if bank fails. FDIC in US.

Money Supply

Total money circulating in economy. Controlled via interest rates and reserves.

Bank Run

Many depositors withdraw simultaneously fearing bank failure. Can be self-fulfilling.

Debit Card

Payment card drawing directly from checking. No borrowing involved.

Credit Card

Payment card borrowing from bank. Interest-free if paid in full; expensive if not.

Wire Transfer

Electronic transfer between banks. Used for large or international transfers.

Neobank

Digital-only bank, no branches. Better rates and lower fees than traditional banks.

Two-Factor Auth (2FA)

Security requiring two verification forms. Essential for safe digital banking.

SWIFT

Global messaging system enabling international bank transfers. 11,000+ banks worldwide.

lessons.html:
Banklar moliya tizimining infratuzilmasi. Har bir ish haqi, har bir xarid, har bir investitsiya banklar orqali o'tadi. Ularning ishlash tartibini tushunish har bir moliyaviy qarorda sizga ustunlik beradi.

Asosiy biznes modeli

Banklar SPREDDAN pul ishlaydi — sizga omonat uchun to'laydigan foiz va qarz oluvchilardan oladigan foiz o'rtasidagi farq. Siz 5% bilan qo'yasiz. Ular 16% bilan kreditlaydi. 11% farq — ularning foydasi.

Qisman zaxira bankligi

Banklar sizning barcha pulingizni seyfda SAQLAMAYDI. Ular faqat bir qismini (odatda 5-15%) zaxira sifatida saqlaydi. Qolganini kreditga beradi.

100 000 so'm qanday 1 000 000 ga aylanadi

Siz 100 000 so'm qo'yasiz. Bank 10 000 ni saqlaydi (10% zaxira), 90 000 ni Alishga kreditga beradi. Alish 90 000 ni sarflaydi — u boshqa bankka tushadi. U bank 9 000 ni saqlaydi, 81 000 ni Malika ga beradi.

Bu davom etadi. Sizning 100 000 so'mingiz pul massasida ~1 000 000 so'm yaratadi. Bu pul multiplikatori — bank tizimi tom ma'noda pul yaratadi.

Bu tizim ishlaydi — juda ko'p odam bir vaqtda pul olishga harakat qilmaguncha (bank hujumi). Shuning uchun omonat sug'urtasi mavjud.

lessons.title: Markaziy bank
lessons.html:
Markaziy bank har qanday mamlakatdagi eng kuchli moliya muassasasi. Uning qarorlari bevosita har bir kredit stavkasiga, omonat stavkasiga va narxlarga ta'sir qiladi.

Markaziy bank nima?

Mamlakatning pul massasini boshqaruvchi, foiz stavkalarini belgilovchi, tijorat banklarini tartibga soluvchi va barqarorlikni ta'minlovchi muassasa. O'zbekistonda — O'zbekiston Respublikasi Markaziy banki (MBRUz).

Asosiy vazifalari

→ 1. Foiz stavkalarini belgilash

Kalit stavka BARCHA kreditlarga ta'sir qiladi. Ko'tarilsa — ipoteka, avtokredit, kartalar qimmatlashadi. Tushirilsa — kreditlar arzonlashadi. Bu iqtisodiyotni boshqarishning asosiy vositasi.

→ 2. Inflyatsiyani nazorat qilish

Odatda 4-5% maqsadli inflyatsiya. Narxlar tez ko'tarilsa — stavka oshiriladi. Iqtisodiyot sekinlashsa — tushiriladi, xarajatlarni rag'batlantirish uchun.

→ 3. Banklarni tartibga solish

Zaxira me'yorlarini, kapital yetarlilik standartlarini belgilaydi. Tekshiruvlar o'tkazadi va xavfli bankni yopishi mumkin.

→ 4. Oxirgi chora kreditchisi

Bank likvidlik inqiroziga duch kelganda, Markaziy bank favqulodda qarz beradi. Bu zanjir bankrotliklarning oldini oladi.

AMALIY MISOL — Stavka o'zgarishi sizga qanday ta'sir qiladi

Markaziy bank kalit stavkani 14% dan 18% ga ko'tardi:

  • Sizning ipotekangiz (o'zgaruvchan stavka): oylik to'lov 200-500 ming so'mga oshadi.

  • Sizning omonatingiz: stavkalar ko'tariladi (lekin banklar sekin o'tkazadi).

  • Fond bozori: odatda tushadi — obligatsiyalar jozibadorroq bo'ladi.

  • Uy-joy bozori: soviydi — ipoteka qimmatlashadi, talab pasayadi.

Bitta qaror sizning ipotekangiz, omonatingiz, investitsiyalaringiz va barcha narxlarga ta'sir qiladi.

lessons.title: Omonat sug'urtasi
lessons.html:
Bankingiz bankrot bo'lsa nima bo'ladi? Banklar har yili bankrot bo'ladi. Omonat sug'urtasi sizni hamma narsani yo'qotishdan himoya qiladi.

Omonat sug'urtasi nima?

Davlat kafolati: bank bankrot bo'lsa, omonatingiz belgilangan limitgacha qaytariladi. O'zbekistonda: 100 000 000 so'mgacha. Rossiyada: 1 400 000 rubl. AQShda: $250 000 (FDIC).

Nima SUG'URTALANGAN

Joriy hisoblar — limitgacha to'liq himoyalangan

Jamg'arma hisoblar — limitgacha to'liq himoyalangan

Muddatli depozitlar — hisoblangan foiz bilan birga

Valyuta omonatlari — bankrotlik kuni kursiga qayta hisoblanadi

Aksiyalar va obligatsiyalar — investitsiya mahsulotlari sug'urtalanmaydi

Payli fondlar va ETF — bank orqali sotib olinsa ham

Kriptovalyuta — davlat himoyasi yo'q

Limitdan ortiq summalar — bir bankda 100 mln so'mdan ortiq sug'urtasiz

Strategiya: limitdan ortiqni qanday sug'urtalash

300 mln so'mingiz bormi? Hammasini bir bankka qo'ymang. Bo'ling: 100 mln A bankda, 100 mln B bankda, 100 mln V bankda. Hammasi to'liq sug'urtalangan.

lessons.title: To'g'ri bankni tanlash
lessons.html:
Ko'pchilik eng yaqin bankda yoki ota-onasi bo'lgan bankda hisob ochadi. Bu passiv tanlov umr bo'yi minglab so'mlik foizlar va keraksiz komissiyalarga tushadi.

Banklarni solishtirish uchun 8 balliq chek-list

1. Foiz stavkalari

Samarali stavkani solishtiring. 10 mln so'mda 1% farq = yiliga 100 000 so'm. 10 yilda 1 mln+ so'm bepul pul.

2. Komissiyalar

Xizmat, bankomat, o'tkazma, overdraft to'lovlari. 50 000 so'm/oy = 600 000 so'm/yil hech narsa uchun.

3. Bankomat tarmog'i

Bepul bankomatlar soni? Har yechishda 5 000 so'm x 4 marta/oy = 240 000 so'm/yil isrof.

4. Raqamli tajriba

Ilova sifati, onlayn-banking, o'tkazmalar qulayligi. Har kuni foydalanasiz — yaxshi ishlashi kerak.

5. Omonat sug'urtasi

Bank sug'urtalanadimi? Limit qancha? Sug'urtalanmagan bankda HECH QACHON pul saqlamang.

6. Mijozlar xizmati

24/7? Telefon, chat, ofis? Muammolar qanchalik tez hal bo'ladi? Haqiqiy sharhlarni o'qing.

7. Mahsulot qatori

Joriy, jamg'arma, depozit, investitsiya, kartalar — kerakli hamma narsa bormi?

8. Obro' va barqarorlik

Bank qancha vaqt ishlaydi? Moliyaviy sog'ligi? Mustaqil reyting agentliklarini tekshiring.

Asosiy xulosa — 6-Blok

Banklar faqat pul saqlash joyi emas — ular har bir moliyaviy qaror o'tadigan infratuzilma. Zaxira bankligi, Markaziy bank siyosati, omonat sug'urtasi va raqamli to'lovlarni tushunish fundamental ustunlik beradi. 8 balliq chek-list bo'yicha ongli tanlang, omonatlarni sug'urtalang va yaxshi stavkalar uchun raqamli bankingdan foydalaning. ZInvest AI banklarni solishtirish, real daromadni hisoblash va hisob tuzilmasini optimallashtirish da yordam beradi.

glossary.title: Atamalar lug'ati
glossary.html:
6-blokdagi barcha muhim tushunchalar

Tijorat banki

Omonat qabul qiladi, kredit beradi, to'lovlarni amalga oshiradi.

Markaziy bank

Pul massasini boshqaradi, stavkalarni belgilaydi, banklarni tartibga soladi. O'zbekistonda — MBRUz.

Qisman zaxira bankligi

Banklar omonatlarning faqat bir qismini saqlaydi, qolganini kreditga beradi. Multiplikator orqali pul yaratadi.

Zaxira me'yori

Bankning saqlashi va kreditga bermasligi kerak bo'lgan omonatlar ulushi. MB tomonidan belgilanadi. Odatda 5-15%.

Kalit stavka

Markaziy bank belgilaydigan, iqtisodiyotdagi barcha boshqa stavkalarga ta'sir qiluvchi stavka.

Omonat sug'urtasi

Bank bankrot bo'lganda omonatchilarning pullari (limitgacha) qaytarilishi kafolati.

Pul massasi

Iqtisodiyotdagi umumiy pul hajmi. Stavkalar va zaxira me'yorlari orqali nazorat qilinadi.

Bank hujumi

Ko'p omonatchilarning bankrotlikdan qo'rqib bir vaqtda pul olishga harakat qilishi.

Debet kartasi

Joriy hisobdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pul yechuvchi to'lov kartasi. Qarz olish yo'q.

Kredit kartasi

Bankdan qarz olish orqali to'lov kartasi. To'liq qaytarilsa foizsiz; aks holda juda qimmat.

Click/Payme

O'zbekistondagi mashhur mobil to'lov tizimlari. Tezkor P2P o'tkazmalar.

Neobank

Filiallarsiz to'liq raqamli bank. Odatda yuqoriroq stavkalar va pastroq komissiyalar.

Ikki bosqichli autentifikatsiya

Ikki tekshirish shaklini talab qiluvchi xavfsizlik usuli. Raqamli banking uchun zarur.

SWIFT

Xalqaro bank o'tkazmalarini amalga oshiruvchi global tizim. Dunyo bo'ylab 11 000+ bank ishlatadi.
